mechanism: Fade transient EUR/USDT perpetual deviation from contemporaneously observable EUR/USDT spot, conditional on an official ECB policy decision. No macro direction label or consensus.
claim_limit: One MEXC leg; unhedged EUR price risk remains. Positive returns would not alone establish a causal cross-venue arbitrage or an independently executable hedge.
reference_identity_gate: Fresh metadata must prove EUR base, USDT quote, TRADING state. MEXC must prove EUR/USDT, active state, strictly positive contractSize, minVol and volUnit; no metadata defaults.

source_hierarchy.primary: MEXC public timestamped full-depth snapshots or correctly bootstrapped/sequence-validated WS depth
source_hierarchy.reference: Binance public timestamped diff-depth WS plus REST bootstrap with documented U/u continuity
source_hierarchy.binance_rest_transport: data-api.binance.vision; same Binance spot product, public market-data-only endpoint. Metadata/rest book capability does not pass timestamped event feed gate.
source_hierarchy.bookticker_limitation: Documented Spot bookTicker has u/s/b/B/a/A, no E/T. Local arrival time is not an exchange timestamp. It cannot alone pass event timing gate.
source_hierarchy.independence: MEXC index origins include Binance. Index is not a second independent venue; Binance remains the single observable external spot reference.

observables: source timestamp UTC milliseconds where provided
full relevant book and update IDs
clock probe send/receive and source clock

sampling.setup_implemented: Bounded REST source-only poller >=5s; no signals/PnL; no event mode. This is not the required event runtime.
sampling.event_required: Continuous timestamped feeds; pair evaluated on 1-second UTC grid using only observations received by that grid instant; no interpolation, carry forward beyond age limit, catch-up signals or missed-grid backfill.
sampling.clock_validation: Server clock probes every 60s, offset by send/receive midpoint; upper offset uncertainty = abs(offset)+RTT/2 must be <=250ms; monotonic/wall clock step >250ms invalidates interval.
sampling.sequence_invalid: Discard local book after reconnect/sequence gap; new validated REST bootstrap required; do not reconstruct missed live evidence.
sampling.stale: SOURCE_INVALID, no signal, no invented timestamp or carry-over.

burn_in.begin: After this method freeze has been committed and a qualified source runtime is running
burn_in.eligible_windows: Monday-Friday 10:00-16:00 UTC; no policy-event windows; setup observations are burned and never economic observations.
burn_in.baseline_bps: Median of 10000*ln(MEXC_mid/Binance_mid) over all eligible valid grids; fixed for all forward events.
burn_in.noise_bps: Nearest-rank quantile 0.995 of abs(basis_bps-baseline_bps) over the same grids.
burn_in.floor_bps: 16 + median MEXC quoted full spread in bps + 2 fixed round-trip slippage bps.
burn_in.finalization: Commit calibration values, dataset chain head, qualification receipt and code hash before 2026-10-26T00:00:00Z; otherwise 29 Oct is not armed. No event-time baseline re-estimation.
burn_in.minimum_failure: OPERATIONALLY_BLOCKED; no convenient shorter calibration or parameter rescue.

event_family: Scheduled ECB monetary policy decisions only; no press conferences, speeches, CPI, NFP, unscheduled decisions, or other currencies.
calendar_change_policy: Only an official schedule amendment known before affected event capture may update date via prospective receipt; retain original dates and no replacement instrument/event family.
T0: Local first completed retrieval of a NEW official ECB monetary-policy release with target event date and substantive policy-decision content. Archive raw bytes, URL, first-seen hash and UTC time. Index/banner hash changes are not T0. Actual global publication time remains unknown; first-seen does not prove earliest access worldwide.
publication_validation: Poll official index and discovered target release every 1s during scheduled time -5m to +10m. Reject redirected/unofficial documents, future-date placeholders, old release, date mismatch, absent policy decision, generic changes. Persist first-seen identity across restarts. Max last-negative to first-positive observation interval 2s and release retrieval RTT 1s; otherwise event SOURCE_INVALID.
event_capture_window: scheduled_release -30m through +15m; no historical retrieval to fill gaps
event_entry_window: T0 inclusive through T0+300s exclusive, capped at scheduled_release+600s; at most first valid qualifying signal per event, same event ID persisted; all positions closed before press conference
event_quality_gate: >=99% valid paired 1s grids during scheduled -5m through last permitted exit; no >5s feed outage, UTC/sequence/publication failure. Quality determined from source evidence, never PnL. Invalid exit or entry invalidates the whole event; retain the excluded event and reason.
signal: excess_bps=10000*ln(MEXC_mid/Binance_mid)-fixed_baseline_bps; abs(excess_bps)>=fixed_trigger_bps; only observables received at decision instant
direction: excess>0 SHORT MEXC; excess<0 LONG MEXC
entry: First subsequent fresh MEXC executable book received 250ms or more after trigger, but <=1000ms after trigger. No same-book/future backfilled fill. LONG asks; SHORT bids. Reject insufficient liquidity/metadata/timing; do not retry the event to rescue fills.
quantity: Per notional, floor N/(worst visible execution-side price*contractSize*volUnit)*volUnit; >=minVol, no upward rounding, no contract size default. Quantity fixed through exit. Reject missing/insufficient book.
exit: First subsequent fresh executable book at entry_receipt+60s to +61s; LONG sells bids, SHORT buys asks. No discretionary early exit, future interpolation, midpoint fills or stale last-price fill.
spread_depth: VWAP of actual appropriate book side for fixed contracts. Spread captured in entry/exit VWAP; no second spread deduction.
fees: 8bps of each actual entry/exit fill notional; fee-only nominal 16bps round trip. Current deployability assumption, no paid API or order used.
slippage: Adverse extra 1bp per side, deducted as 2bps on initial entry notional; depth impact separately represented in VWAP.
funding: Invalid if a funding timestamp occurs inside holding interval and public contemporaneous funding evidence is absent. Otherwise apply documented public rate and side to actual notional; never assume zero at a boundary.
net_bps: 10000*direction_sign*(exit_vwap/entry_vwap-1)-8*(1+exit_vwap/entry_vwap)-2-funding_bps; fixed USD linear contract quantity; single leg
reporting_unit: ECB event. Eligible no-signal event contributes 0bps. Source-invalid event is retained but not assigned an invented return. Do not count every tick as an independent sample.
sample: One analysis after first 8 source-valid events from the 10 fixed scheduled dates. No interim economic pass/fail and no PnL-based event exclusion. If fewer than 8 valid after final date: OPERATIONALLY_BLOCKED for insufficient defensible event coverage, not NO_EDGE.
statistics: Primary 25 USDT event net mean; exact one-sided sign-flip test of positive mean over 2^8 sign assignments, including ties, with null symmetry assumption stated. Event independence/symmetry not guaranteed; report raw event series and uncertainty; no claim that 8 events prove durable profitability.
multiplicity: Single primary instrument/direction algorithm/horizon/notional/test; 10/50/100 notionals descriptive only and cannot promote if 25 fails. No horizons/pairs compete for rescue.
PASS: After exactly 8 valid events: primary mean net>0 and exact one-sided signflip p<=0.05, all authority/source/cost/evidence gates valid. FORWARD_PASS is research-only, no live trading authority.
FAIL: After exactly 8 valid events: valid economic test does not meet both mean and p gates -> FORWARD_FAIL.
COLLECTING: Runtime qualified and sample <8 -> FORWARD_COLLECTING; zero or one event never forced to PASS/FAIL.
BLOCKED: Critical inaccessible source -> SOURCE_BLOCKED for that path. Local runtime, qualification, burn-in or implementation failure -> OPERATIONALLY_BLOCKED; no economic failure fabricated.
development: None economically; technical prospective burn-in only
OOS_holdout: All listed forward ECB outcomes protected; no historical event outcome authorized by setup
activation_gate: Dedicated event runtime, publication detection, latency/clock/continuity/persistence tests and burn-in all pass; immutable calibration/activation receipt committed before first event. This setup collector cannot activate even if endpoint HTTP status improves.
no_tuning: No thresholds, costs, horizon, currencies, sources, event lists or tests changed after outcome. Technical repairs preserving science require explicit receipts. If declared authority cannot be implemented, keep blocked.
